There are always many people at the old town. Ben learned a lot about art. Max is interested in cooking. For example, my British friend invited me to try fish and chips.
Last Tuesday, Ben and Max went to the ticket office. Ben hopes to visit Paris one day. They took many photos at the old town. The lights went out inexplicably at midnight last night.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the ticket office by bike. Ben is going to travel to Paris in February. Ben bought a pair of shoes at the shop yesterday. The arrival of the train was delayed.
Max's birthday is in February. Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Ben and Max had great fun there.
